audience: Argentine businesses that send approved WhatsApp template messages through Regi

useCases.title: Find the sender number for a send
useCases.text: List the WhatsApp Business numbers of the account. Each id is the phone number id that a send needs.

useCases.title: Review the approved message templates
useCases.text: List the templates with their language, category and status. Only approved templates can be sent. The variables show how many values the body needs.

useCases.title: Send an approved template to one recipient
useCases.text: Send one approved template to one recipient. Each message is billed and reaches a real person. Values fill the variables in order.
